summary: This backlog outlines the implementation of a centralized, secure, and resilient AWS Backup framework for RDS and DynamoDB resources across a multi-tenant platform.

epics.title: Centralized Backup Framework
epics.description: Establish a centralized multi-tenanted platform backup framework using AWS Backup to enforce consistent data protection across all tenant accounts.

features.description: Implement the governance and policy enforcement mechanisms required to manage backups across multiple AWS accounts within the organization.
features.title: Multi-tenant AWS Backup Governance

acceptance_criteria: Verify that a centralized AWS Backup policy is applied to all accounts in the AWS Organization.
Confirm RDS and DynamoDB resources are successfully identified for backup inclusion via tags or other identifiers.
stories.title: Deploy Centralized Backup Policies
stories.description: As a Platform Administrator, I want to deploy centralized backup policies so that all tenant data resources are automatically included in the backup framework.
As a Platform Administrator, I want to prevent tenants from modifying backup configurations so that the integrity of the backup framework is maintained.
acceptance_criteria: Attempting to modify the AWS Backup configuration from a tenant-level DevOps role results in an 'Access Denied' error.
stories.title: Enforce Backup Configuration Lockdown

acceptance_criteria: Confirm that RDS and DynamoDB resources with the specified backup tags are correctly picked up by the AWS Backup plan.
stories.description: As a Tenant Engineer, I want to tag my resources for backup inclusion so that I can control which data resources are protected by the central framework.
stories.title: Implement Resource Tagging for Backups

acceptance_criteria: Confirm that a backup vault in a separate AWS account contains copies of backups from the workload accounts.
Verify that tenant IAM roles have no 'Write' or 'Delete' permissions on the backup vault in the dedicated account.
stories.description: As a Platform Administrator, I want to store backup copies in a dedicated account so that they are protected from accidental or malicious deletion in the source account.
stories.title: Provision Isolated Backup Vaults

stories.description: As a Security Architect, I want to use independent KMS keys for backup encryption so that the deletion of source keys does not impact the ability to recover data.
acceptance_criteria: Verify that the KMS key ID used for the backup in the dedicated account is different from the key ID used for the source instance.
Confirm tenants do not have 'kms:Decrypt' or 'kms:DescribeKey' permissions for the backup keys.
stories.title: Configure Independent KMS Encryption

stories.description: As a Platform Administrator, I want to restrict KMS key deletion via SCPs so that the keys required for data recovery cannot be destroyed.
stories.title: Implement SCPs for Key Protection
acceptance_criteria: Verify that a Service Control Policy (SCP) prevents 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion' for the backup CMKs by tenant roles.

features.description: Set up the cross-account infrastructure and encryption controls to isolate backup data from the source workload accounts.
features.title: Secure Cross-Account Vault & Encryption

epics.title: Cross-Account Backup Storage & Security
epics.description: Ensure backups are stored in a dedicated, secure platform account with independent encryption keys to prevent data loss from tenant-level compromises.

features.title: Lifecycle & Recovery Management
features.description: Implement automated retention policies and documented restoration processes to meet RPO and compliance targets.

acceptance_criteria: Verify that production workload backups remain available in the local account for a minimum of 30 days.
stories.description: As a Compliance Officer, I want production backups to be retained for 30 days to meet operational and regulatory requirements.
stories.title: Configure Production Retention Policies
Configure Non-Prod Retention Policies
stories.description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want non-production backups to be retained for 15 days to support development and testing needs.
acceptance_criteria: Verify that non-production workload backups remain available in the local account for a minimum of 15 days.

stories.description: As a Business Owner, I want a defined restore process so that data can be recovered within 12 hours in the event of a failure.
acceptance_criteria: A documented and tested procedure for restoring an RDS/DynamoDB instance from the dedicated backup account exists.
Confirm that the backup schedule frequency is sufficient to meet a 12-hour Recovery Point Objective (RPO).
stories.title: Document and Test Restore Process

epics.title: Data Retention & Recovery
epics.description: Manage the lifecycle of backup data and establish recovery procedures to meet business continuity requirements.

name: Cloudscaler RDS Backup Framework Portfolio Backlog
